reviewer: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) with a fresh-context medium reviewer subagent

claims.summary: Boolean image values: for every refutation the noncommutative depth audit's compiler accepts, compiled with its used inputs first (translations L_k=F_k+R_k), and every Boolean point a with free placeholders, C_pi(a,Y)=sum_(k<=i*)(Y_k+rho_k) - eps(a)(beta_(i*) + sum_(k<i*) w_k(a) gamma_(i*,k)), where i* is the first used input with L_k(a)=1, eps(a)=1 iff no later used input has L_k(a)=1, rho_k input k's correction certificate, beta_k the supplied certificate of L_k^2-L_k, gamma_(i*,k) the product-rule certificate of [L_(i*),L_k], all evaluated at a, and w_k(a) in F_2 the sum of a_nk(a)b_nk(a) over the slots citing k of the non-input lines up to the first one false at a. The initial segment A_t of thm:used-node-jet-erasure and every member of the matched jet envelope have the same form with every w_k=1. So the clause and Boolean-generator coordinates are fixed by the ordered used input list, and the commutator coordinates differ from A_t's exactly by -eps sum_(k<i*)(w_k-1)gamma_(i*,k).
claims.assessment: Working direct evaluation of the compiler's prefix sum at a Boolean point, with the product-rule form of the commutator certificates and the rule identities at the first false non-input line; the Boolean-generator coordinates also follow from cor:coefficient-cube-traces. Passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer after it found the first draft's claim of fixed commutator coordinates false.
claims.rationale: Shows the clause and Boolean-generator values of inputs-first matched images at Boolean points carry no proof information, and locates the possible proof information in the commutator coordinates, through citation counts the transformed images set to one.
claims.next_action: Decide whether the free identity C(X,F)=1 fixes the commutator coordinates at Boolean points (a noncommutative analogue of cor:coefficient-cube-traces), or find refutations on the same inputs with different w_k(a).
